meta.command: one-off comparison script in the cloud session (not in the repo); method below

git.note: not run inside a git repository

inputs.pilot_records: work/extract_pilot/1101_2025_pairs.jsonl (= pilot/tcc_pairs.jsonl fields), pilot PDF sha256 32297641063f0f5d6e0516aa9e7d00b2d6dfb851aef5fbd3b8c495c987983225

method: A pilot picture 'has a match' when an official picture on the same page overlaps it with IoU > 0.8. For pilot pictures without a match, the official PDF page is searched for an image placement overlapping the same box (IoU > 0.5) and its stored pixel size is read (pymupdf get_image_info).
reading: The official (amended) filing stores 台泥's photos at about half the resolution of the company-website copy. 32 pictures shrink below the 150 px floor in extract_pairs.py (MIN_PX) and are dropped. The other differences (26 missing places, 35 new places) were not traced; the official file is the 2026/10/02 amended edition, so content or layout changes are possible. 葡萄王 2025 gives identical numbers for both files.
